additional_info.subject: Note for NOC
additional_info.body:
Currently the charger is in operation: once not in use
Please follow the steps as per Product Issue report
1. Support RC on troubleshooting procedures (1.1 to 1.3).
In case of fault happening on v6.0, move to ES to follow up on investigation
1.1 Check if rebooting the charger clears the issue (SW bug clearance procedure).
If yes, Fwd to ES
and ask to collect and report EcoG Logs
1.2 If data from visual inspection is already available, report the damages in the ticket notes for handover,
then FWD to ES
.
1.3 Please update to v6.0 or newer, as logging has been improved from v6.0 on
2. Forward the case to ES to follow up on investigation between RC and ES
